detail.title: CP-UNR-4K5644-FI
features: Up to 64 channel IP camera input
Max. 32 × 1080p@30 fps or 32 × 2MP@30 fps decoding capability
Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264, MJPEG codec decoding
AI by Recorder: Supports 2 Channel face detection and recognition, up to 20 face databases and 20,000 face images, 4 Channel Perimeter protection, 8 Channel SMD Plus
Support 4 SATA HDDs up to 20TB Each, 3 USB Ports (2 USB 3.0 Ports)

General.AI by Camera: Face detection, Face recognition, Video metadata (human, motor vehicles, and non-motor  vehicles), Perimeter protection, SMD Plus, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People counting, ANPR, Vehicle density, Heat map
General.AI by NVR: Face detection, Face recognition, Perimeter protection, SMD Plus
General.Perimeter Performance AI by NVR: 4 Channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel
General.Face Detection AI by NVR: 2 channels (up to 12 face images/s each channel)
General.Abnormality Alarm: Camera offline, Storage error, Disk full, IP conflict, MAC conflict, Login lock, Abnormal  behaviour of fan, Cyber security exception
General.Face Attributes: Gender, Age group, Glasses, Expressions, Face mask, Beard
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 20 face databases with 20,000 images, with a total capacity of 2.5 G. Name, Gender,  Birthday, Address, Credential type, Credential No., Countries & Regions and state can be added to each face image
General.SMD Plus by NVR: 8 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, Reducing false alarms caused by leaves, Rain and lighting condition change
General.Face Recognition AI by NVR: 1. 16-channel FD (by camera) + FR (by recorder), image stream: 16 face images/s 2. 2-channe FD (by recorder) + FR (by recorder), video stream: 12 face images/s
General.Network Bandwidth: AI disabled: 384 Mbps incoming, 384 Mbps recording and 384 Mbps outgoing  AI enabled: 200 Mbps incoming, 200 Mbps recording and 200 Mbps outgoing
General.Network Mode: Multi-address mode, load balance, fault tolerance and other network port binding modes
General.Resolution: 32 MP, 24 MP, 16 MP, 12 MP, 8 MP, 6 MP, 5 MP, 4 MP, 3 MP, 1080p, 720p, 960p, D1, CIF,  QCIF
General.IntelliCheck AI by Camera + Recorder: Max. 32 Channel, 1 Combined event per Channel/s
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 2 Channel 32 MP@25 fps, 2 Channel 24 MP@25 fps, 4 Channel 16 MP@30 fps,  5 Channel 12 MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 8 MP@30 fps, 10 Channel 6 MP@30 fps, 12 Channel 5  MP@30 fps, 16 Channel 4 MP@30 fps, 32 Channel 1080p@30 fps  AI enabled: 1 Channel 32 MP@25 fps, 1 Channel 24 MP@25 fps, 2 Channel 16 MP@30 fps,  4 Channel 12 MP@30 fps, 6 Channel 8 MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 6 MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 5  MP@30 fps, 12 Channel 4 MP@30 fps, 24 Channel 1080p@30 fps
General.Non-motor Vehicle: Vehicle model, Vehicle color, Number of persons, Helmet.
General.License Plate Database Capacity: 1. Create up to 20,000 plate numbers. 2. Blocklist and allow list
General.Motor Vehicle Attributes: License plate, Plate color, Vehicle body, Vehicle model, Vehicle logo, Calling, Seatbelt, Vehicle interior, Vehicle registration location
General.Human Attributes: Top color, Top type, Bottom color, Bottom type, Hat, Bag, Age, Gender and Umbrella
General.Disk Interface: 4 SATA ports, each disk can contain up to 20 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, Local alarm, Alarm box, Camera external alarm, Network alarm, Scene changing, PIR alarm, Thermal alarm
General.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection, Perimeter protection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor  vehicles, and non-motor vehicles), SMD Plus, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People counting, ANPR, Vehicle density, Heat map
General.Recording Mode: General, Motion detection, Intelligent, Alarm, POS
General.Playback: instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback (face and motion detection)
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot, Local alarm output, IPC external alarm output, Access controller, Audio, Buzzer, Log, Preset, Email
General.Interface Ports: 3 (1 front USB 2.0 port, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports), 2 HDMI, 2 VGA, 1 RS232, 1 eSATA Port, 1 RS485
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, DDNS, Alarm Server,  Multicast, P2P, Auto Registration, iSCSI, ONVIF 23.12(Profile T/ Profile S/ Profile G), CGI, SDK
